---
title: "Keyboard Shortcuts"
---

Open **Keyboard Shortcuts** from the Command Palette to search actions, inspect conflicts, and change bindings. Select the edit icon beside a command, enter the new key combination, and press Enter.

RHS-IA inherits familiar editor shortcuts and adds data-science actions. **Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+P** opens the Command Palette, **Cmd/Ctrl+&#96;** toggles the terminal, and **Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+H** opens Documentation. On macOS, `Cmd` commonly replaces `Ctrl`.

Changes are stored in your user keybindings. Use the context-menu reset action to restore a command's default.

[Open Keyboard Shortcuts](rhs-doc-action:keyboard-shortcuts).
